### :material-code-braces: Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template — `DATA_ROOT` via `--data-root`, the rest via `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | Root directory containing eager output (fastqc/, adapterremoval/, samtools/, deduplication/, damageprofiler/, qualimap/, preseq/, endorspy/, bcftools/, pipeline_info/) plus the reprocessed multiqc/multiqc_data/multiqc.parquet, and the run's --input TSV under input/ (see the LAYOUT NOTE above). |
| `SHORT_FRAGMENT_BP` | — | Short-fragment cut-off in bp. The damageprofiler/authenticity recipe counts fragments shorter than it (column fraction_under_70bp, name kept for schema stability) and the Authentication tab names it (card title and fragment-length intro). |

<tr><td><code>samples</code> <span class="col">·&nbsp;sample_id</span></td><td class="arr">→</td><td><code>damageprofiler_authenticity</code></td><td>Filter the authenticity plane by the libraries picked in the left panel</td></tr>
<tr><td><code>samples</code> <span class="col">·&nbsp;sample_id</span></td><td class="arr">→</td><td><code>endorspy_endogenous</code></td><td>Filter the endogenous DNA tiles by the libraries picked in the left panel</td></tr>
<tr><td><code>samples</code> <span class="col">·&nbsp;sample_id</span></td><td class="arr">→</td><td><code>picard_markduplicates_metrics</code></td><td>Filter the duplication metrics by the libraries picked in the left panel</td></tr>
<tr><td><code>samples</code> <span class="col">·&nbsp;sample_id</span></td><td class="arr">→</td><td><code>eager_lane_stats</code></td><td>Filter the per-lane trimming table by the libraries picked in the left panel</td></tr>
<tr><td><code>samples</code> <span class="col">·&nbsp;sample_id</span></td><td class="arr">→</td><td><code>eager_read_fate</code></td><td>Filter the read-fate flow by the libraries picked in the left panel</td></tr>
<tr><td><code>samples</code> <span class="col">·&nbsp;sample_name</span></td><td class="arr">→</td><td><code>bcftools_stats_summary</code></td><td>Filter the variant counts by the biological samples behind the libraries picked in the left panel</td></tr>
<tr><td><code>samples</code> <span class="col">·&nbsp;sample_name</span></td><td class="arr">→</td><td><code>bcftools_stats_tstv</code></td><td>Filter the Ts to Tv ratio by the biological samples behind the libraries picked in the left panel</td></tr>
<tr><td><code>damageprofiler_misincorporation</code> <span class="col">·&nbsp;sample</span></td><td class="arr">→</td><td><code>qualimap_bamqc_genome_results</code></td><td>Carry a library selected on the damage profile over to its coverage row</td></tr>
<tr><td><code>damageprofiler_misincorporation</code> <span class="col">·&nbsp;sample</span></td><td class="arr">→</td><td><code>preseq_complexity_curve</code></td><td>Carry a library selected on the damage profile over to its complexity curve</td></tr>
<tr><td><code>damageprofiler_authenticity</code> <span class="col">·&nbsp;sample</span></td><td class="arr">→</td><td><code>damageprofiler_lgdistribution</code></td><td>Carry a library selected on the authenticity plane over to its full length profile</td></tr>
<tr><td><code>endorspy_endogenous</code> <span class="col">·&nbsp;sample</span></td><td class="arr">→</td><td><code>samtools_flagstat</code></td><td>Carry a library selected on the endogenous DNA tiles over to its flagstat rows</td></tr>
<tr><td><code>qualimap_bamqc_genome_results</code> <span class="col">·&nbsp;sample</span></td><td class="arr">→</td><td><code>samples</code></td><td>Carry a coverage or duplication floor to the library hub, and through it to every tab</td></tr>
<tr><td><code>endorspy_endogenous</code> <span class="col">·&nbsp;sample</span></td><td class="arr">→</td><td><code>samples</code></td><td>Carry an endogenous-DNA floor to the library hub, and through it to every tab</td></tr>
<tr><td><code>samples</code> <span class="col">·&nbsp;sample_id</span></td><td class="arr">→</td><td><code>eager_library_qc</code></td><td>Filter the per-library QC profile by the libraries picked in the left panel</td></tr>
<tr><td><code>samples</code> <span class="col">·&nbsp;sample_id</span></td><td class="arr">→</td><td><code>qualimap_mapq_across_reference</code></td><td>Filter the mapping-quality track by the libraries picked in the left panel</td></tr>
<tr><td><code>qualimap_coverage_across_reference</code> <span class="col">·&nbsp;chromosome</span></td><td class="arr">→</td><td><code>qualimap_mapq_across_reference</code></td><td>A region brushed or typed on the depth navigator narrows the mapping-quality track</td></tr>
</tbody></table></div>

### :material-chef-hat: Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `EXPECTED_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`adapterremoval/settings.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/adapterremoval/settings.py) | Trimming and collapsing statistics from an AdapterRemoval settings report. | `sample`, `total_read_pairs`, `total_reads`, `well_aligned_read_pairs`, `unaligned_read_pairs`, `discarded_reads`, `singleton_reads`, `collapsed_pairs`, `truncated_collapsed_pairs`, `retained_reads`, `retained_nucleotides`, `average_retained_length`, `collapse_rate`, `discard_rate` |
| [`bcftools/stats_summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/bcftools/stats_summary.py) | Per-sample, per-caller variant record counts from `bcftools stats`. | `sample`, `caller`, `n_records`, `n_no_alts`, `n_snps`, `n_mnps`, `n_indels`, `n_others`, `n_multiallelic_sites`, `n_multiallelic_snp_sites`, `snp_fraction`, `log10_n_records` |
| [`bcftools/stats_tstv.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/bcftools/stats_tstv.py) | Per-sample, per-caller transition/transversion ratio from `bcftools stats`. | `sample`, `caller`, `ts`, `tv`, `ts_tv`, `ts_1st_alt`, `tv_1st_alt`, `ts_tv_1st_alt` |
| [`damageprofiler/authenticity.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/damageprofiler/authenticity.py) | The ancient-DNA authenticity plane: terminal deamination against fragment length. | `sample`, `ct_5p_first`, `ga_3p_first`, `terminal_damage`, `background`, `mean_length`, `median_length`, `fraction_under_70bp`, `n_reads` |
| [`damageprofiler/lgdistribution.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/damageprofiler/lgdistribution.py) | Fragment-length distribution of a mapped library, from DamageProfiler. | `sample`, `strand`, `series`, `length`, `occurrences`, `fraction` |
| [`damageprofiler/misincorporation.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/damageprofiler/misincorporation.py) | Ancient-DNA misincorporation frequency by position, both read ends, one row | `sample`, `end`, `position`, `base_change`, `frequency` |
| [`endorspy/endogenous.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/endorspy/endogenous.py) | Endogenous DNA percentage per library, from endorS.py's MultiQC custom content. | `sample`, `endogenous_dna`, `endogenous_dna_post`, `endogenous_dna_loss`, `off_target_pct` |
| [`nf-core/eager/complexity_curve.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/eager/recipes/complexity_curve.py) | eager-local override of `depictio/catalog/preseq/complexity_curve.py`. | `sample`, `total_reads`, `expected_distinct`, `lower_ci`, `upper_ci`, `ci_width` |
| [`nf-core/eager/lane_stats.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/eager/recipes/lane_stats.py) | One row per sequencing LANE, joining AdapterRemoval's report to the samplesheet. | `lane_id`, `sample_id`, `sample_name`, `lane`, `run_accession`, `seq_type`, `strandedness`, `total_read_pairs`, `total_reads`, `discarded_reads`, `collapsed_pairs`, `retained_reads`, `retained_nucleotides`, `average_retained_length`, `collapse_rate`, `discard_rate` |
| [`nf-core/eager/library_qc.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/eager/recipes/library_qc.py) | One row per library pooling the numbers an ancient-DNA library is judged on. | `sample`, `endogenous_dna`, `endogenous_dna_post`, `clonality_pct`, `mean_coverage`, `mean_mapping_quality`, `error_rate_pct`, `gc_percentage`, `ct_5p_first_pct`, `mean_length` |
| [`nf-core/eager/mapq_across_reference.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/eager/recipes/mapq_across_reference.py) | Mapping quality along the reference, from Qualimap BamQC's windowed table. | `sample`, `chromosome`, `position`, `mapping_quality`, `global_position` |
| [`nf-core/eager/read_fate.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/eager/recipes/read_fate.py) | Where every sequenced read of a library ends up, as a flow of read counts. | `sample`, `step_sequencing`, `step_trimming`, `step_mapping`, `step_filtering`, `step_duplication`, `reads` |
| [`nf-core/eager/samples.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/eager/recipes/samples.py) | One row per eager LIBRARY, from the TSV samplesheet the run was launched with. | `sample_id`, `sample_name`, `organism`, `seq_type`, `udg_treatment`, `n_lanes`, `lane_ids` |
| [`picard/markduplicates_metrics.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/picard/markduplicates_metrics.py) | Duplication metrics from a Picard MarkDuplicates report. | `sample`, `library`, `unpaired_reads_examined`, `read_pairs_examined`, `unmapped_reads`, `unpaired_read_duplicates`, `read_pair_duplicates`, `read_pair_optical_duplicates`, `duplicate_reads`, `reads_after_dedup`, `percent_duplication`, `estimated_library_size` |
| [`qualimap/bamqc_genome_results.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/qualimap/bamqc_genome_results.py) | One row per sample from a Qualimap BamQC `genome_results.txt` report. | `sample`, `total_reads`, `mapped_reads`, `percentage_aligned`, `mean_coverage`, `mean_mapping_quality`, `general_error_rate`, `gc_percentage`, `duplication_rate` |
| [`qualimap/coverage_across_reference.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/qualimap/coverage_across_reference.py) | Read depth along the reference, from Qualimap BamQC's own windowed table. | `sample`, `chromosome`, `position`, `coverage`, `coverage_std`, `global_position` |
| [`qualimap/coverage_histogram.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/qualimap/coverage_histogram.py) | How many bases of the reference sit at each depth, from Qualimap BamQC. | `sample`, `coverage`, `n_genomic_locations`, `fraction` |
| [`qualimap/coverage_per_contig.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/qualimap/coverage_per_contig.py) | Per-contig depth, from the ``Coverage per contig`` block of genome_results.txt. | `sample`, `chromosome`, `length`, `mapped_bases`, `mean_coverage`, `coverage_std`, `relative_coverage` |
| [`qualimap/genome_fraction_coverage.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/qualimap/genome_fraction_coverage.py) | What share of the reference is covered at least X deep, from Qualimap BamQC. | `sample`, `min_coverage`, `genome_fraction_pct` |
| [`samtools/flagstat.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/samtools/flagstat.py) | One row per (sample, filter stage) from a `samtools flagstat` report. | `sample`, `stage`, `total_reads`, `mapped_reads`, `mapped_pct`, `duplicate_reads`, `properly_paired_reads`, `properly_paired_pct`, `singleton_pct` |
